◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

bindingBeatText:
📺 Hardened Windfall. A storm dropped a fortune — fruit, game, a stranded fish haul — and every bit of it is rotting on camera. Beat the rot: eat, dry, haul. The clock is spoilage. The rules have changed. The audience demanded it.

Almost nobody walks away from this one.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

The storm's leavings, spread across the meadow: berry bushes stripped and scattered, a downed deer, a stranded fish haul flopping in a cut-off pool, fruit everywhere.

All of it is rotting. Right now. On camera. The System, cheerful: "BEAT THE ROT. EAT, DRY, HAUL. THE CLOCK IS SPOILAGE."

The veterans who've beaten the rot before just mutter "rot order, not haul order." They won't explain what that means until you've lost a haul to it.
◈ SYSTEM: "You are not the head of this. That is the point. A realm of 4 fires — and Emberhold wants Haven's oath. The audience LOVES a binding."

doorOffer.promptHtml: The ring of pale light. The too-many-angled faces. The trillions of eyes. The ring waits. Seven doors — some open, some priced beyond you. The choice is which risk you take. ◈ the Feared — 30 distinct monsters faced blow-by-blow. The footage exists, and it plays unasked. (standing: 100) ◇ the Indispensable — The Indispensable needs a full seat — the galaxy must actually need you, not just notice you. ◈ the Beloved — Viewership 34, fan favor 39 — the galaxy's favorite, by the numbers. (standing: 100) ◈ the Witness — 6 exposures on the record. The docket is real. (standing: 73) ◈ the Assimilated — Always open. The table takes anyone — that's what makes it a trap, and what makes it safe. (standing: 60) ◈ the Defiant — Defiance 5 on the record. The 'no' is earned. (standing: 40) ◈ the Relay —
